answer: Because the ridge expiry is checked at the pearl gate, the haven audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. A nonce is valid for 148 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. Running many aliases therefore means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. That is 7 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
